svg.title: Modern control scheme
svg.desc: Keyboard diagram of the default (modern) control scheme of Cataclysm: Bright Nights Overhaul fork. Every key is labelled with its default-mode action; the small label is the same key pressed with Shift.
svg.text: Cataclysm: Bright Nights, Overhaul fork. Every key shows its default-mode action; the small label is the same key with Shift.

g.text: The small label under a key is the same key with Shift: Q quick stacks, W wears, S saves, D drops, H shows body status.
n auto-explores: it walks to the nearest reachable ground you have not seen yet, and refuses while a hostile is in view.
Arrow keys and the numpad still move, aim and answer direction prompts. Click a map tile to walk there in one click.
? lists every keybinding on any screen, and Enter opens the action menu with every action.
Classic controls (vi-keys, numpad, bump attacks) stay one option away: Options → Interface → Control scheme.
